question: Is the 1957 Kincaid/Kimbrell oil test in any online RRC imaged-records collection?
well: GC&SF RR CO Sec 3 A-159, Upton Co; drilled 1957; plugged-back oil test -> water well; no API

collections_checked.result: 0 Kimbrell/Kimble operators; Upton 'Kincaid' leases are deep modern wells only
all Upton dry holes are 1980s-2000s; only Upton 'Kimbell' lease record = ARCO Kimbell #1 (API 46132677, 1987)
0 Kimbrell; 1 Upton 'Kincaid' = Bell Petroleum, deep Bend (10400 ft)
0 Kimbrell; Upton 'Kincaid' = ARCO/Forest deep well at TC RR Sec 3 A-386 (different survey); nothing at GC&SF Sec 3/A-159
roll read in full; Upton section is 1966-1968 records; the 1957 well does not appear (handwritten forms don't OCR)
organized by producing field; a dry hole has no potential test; ruled out
1957 postdates this film; excluded by era

conclusion: The 1957 oil test predates every digitized online collection. Dry Hole Files IS a separate collection but is 2000+ only. The record survives only in the pre-1965 physical operator file at RRC Central Records.
key_corroboration: ARCO 1987 W-1 plat (API 46132677, evidence/arco_kimbell_sec3_plat_1987.png) is labelled 'Kimbell Lease, Section 3, Abstract 159, G C & S F RR CO, Upton County' -- confirming the survey and that the section's oil lease is the Kimbell lease (Kincaid = surface owner).
